translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 30.12.2020 (radio)
A record warm year. Finns' wish to move. Corona vaccine. Corona figures in Sweden and Finland. Landslide in Norway.
## The year 2020 was a record warm year
![Map of changes in the Earth's temperature. The polar regions have warmed the most.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11702625)
Open image viewer
Map of changes in the Earth's temperature. The polar regions have warmed the most. Photo: Copernicus Climate Change Service/ECMWF
This year, 2020, has been the warmest year in Finland since measurements began.
The average temperature this year has been about one degree higher than the previous record. The previous record warm year in Finland was 2015.

Mika Rantanen, a researcher at the Finnish Meteorological Institute, says that the northern areas of the Earth have been warmer than usual this year. For example, in Siberia November was in places more than 10 degrees warmer than usual.
## Finns' wish to move
The corona crisis has not made city people dream of moving to the countryside.

In December Yle asked Finns where they prefer to live if money or a job does not limit their choice. The largest part, 53 percent, said that they want to live near a big city or in a small town. About 15 percent want to live in the city centre and 26 percent want to live in the countryside.
A similar survey was also made 4 years ago. The results were also similar then.
## Giving the corona vaccine
![Pfizer-BioNTech corona vaccine in close-up.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5568,h_3132,x_0,y_287/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7572125fe31f7eaed3d/1608720313)
Open image viewer
The Pfizer-BioNTech corona vaccine. Photo: ullstein bild - Sven Simon/ All Over Press
The Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare has changed the instructions for giving the corona vaccine.

Until now, 5 doses of vaccine have been taken from a bottle of the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine. However, there is often a lot of extra vaccine left in the bottle. From now on, if there is enough vaccine, 6 doses can be taken from a bottle.
Earlier today it was reported that in Norway and also in Finland, surplus vaccine doses may have been thrown in the bin.
## Corona figures in Sweden and Finland

![A sign in a shop door in Haparanda reminds people about keeping distance.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_282/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7224895f6b53358250e/1600869241)
Open image viewer
A sign on the shop door reminds people about safe distances. Photo: Annu Passoja / Yle
In Sweden a large number of corona deaths has been reported in one day.
The Swedish public broadcaster SVT says that 243 new corona deaths have been reported in Sweden. In total, more than 8,700 people have died of corona in Sweden.
In Finland, 6 new corona deaths have been reported today. A little over 550 people have died of corona here.
Almost 440 new infections were reported today in Finland and over 8,800 in Sweden.
## Landslide in Norway
![A ravine created by the landslide in Gjerdrum.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11719028)
Open image viewer
The landslide opened a ravine in the village of Gjerdrum. Photo: Fredrik Hagen / EPA
There has been a landslide in Norway.
The landslide happened in the early hours of the morning in Gjerdrum, about 30 kilometres from the capital, Oslo.
At least 9 people were injured in the landslide.
The landslide swept away several houses. Hundreds of people have been evacuated from the area.
